samples.question: This picture is a 6 by 6 block of square rooms. Walls are solid ink, and you may walk between two rooms only through a doorway gap in the wall between them. Four rooms have a coloured floor: orange, green, blue and pink. Exactly one of them stands on a round trip: starting there you can walk away and come back to it without ever passing through the same doorway twice. From each of the other three, every walk that returns has to go back through a doorway it already used. Which coloured room is it? Answer with exactly one of: orange, green, blue, pink.
